_meta.description: Verbatim per-class normality rules from LogicQA, used as the natural-language constraint input for MVTec-LOCO.
_meta.source: LogicQA (Kwon et al., ACL 2025 Industry), Appendix C.2 'MVTec LOCO AD Dataset - Normality Definition for each class'
_meta.upstream: MVTec LOCO AD (Bergmann et al., IJCV 2022, 'Beyond Dents and Scratches')
_meta.note: Verbatim copy of LogicQA's bulleted per-class rules. Template slots {fruit}, {color} are kept as-is; they are specialized per-image at runtime.

bullets.text: The breakfast box always contain exactly two tangerines and one nectarine that are always located on the left-hand side of the box.
The ratio and relative position of the cereals and the mix of banana chips and almonds on the right-hand side are fixed.
The juice bottle is filled with {fruit} juice and carries exactly two labels.
bullets.mvtec_origin: templated from MVTec 'one of three differently colored liquids ... carries exactly two labels'

bullets.text: The first label is attached to the center of the bottle, with the {fruit} icon positioned exactly at the center of the label, clearly indicating the type of {fruit} juice.
bullets.mvtec_origin: expanded from MVTec 'displays an icon that determines the type of liquid'

bullets.text: The second is attached to the lower part of the bottle with the text "100% Juice" written on it.
The fill level is the same for each bottle.
The bottle is filled with at least 90% of its capacity with juice, but not 100%.
bullets.mvtec_origin: NEW - added by LogicQA, not in MVTec

bullets.text: Each compartment of the box of pushpins contains exactly one pushpin.
A screw bag contains exactly two washers, two nuts, one long screw, and one short screw.
All bolts (screws) are longer than 3 times the diameter of the washer.
bullets.mvtec_origin: NEW - added by LogicQA, not in MVTec

bullets.text: Exactly two splicing connectors with the same number of cable clamps are linked by exactly one cable.
In addition, the number of clamps has a one-to-one correspondence to the {color} of the cable.
bullets.mvtec_origin: templated from MVTec 'color of the cable'

bullets.text: The cable must be connected to the same position on both connectors to maintain mirror symmetry.
bullets.mvtec_origin: paraphrase of MVTec 'terminate in the same relative position on its two ends such that the whole construction exhibits a mirror symmetry'

bullets.text: The cable length is roughly longer than the length of the splicing connector terminal block.
bullets.mvtec_origin: NEW - added by LogicQA, not in MVTec
